lessons.title: Deep headings, nested quotes and comments
lessons.file: A01 Deep headings, nested quotes and comments.md

steps.text: Type level 5 and 6 headings by hand
steps.hint: The menu stops at 4; 5 and 6 take five and six hash signs

steps.text: Nest a quote inside another quote
steps.hint: Start the line with two greater-than signs in a row

steps.text: Write a comment the preview does not draw
steps.hint: The comment goes between <!-- and -->

steps.text: Write the properties block with two keys
steps.hint: Three dashes, the keys and three dashes, at the top of the note

steps.text: Look at the preview's properties table
steps.hint: The table sits under the header, one row per key

steps.text: Check that cover and icon are not in the table
steps.hint: cover and icon are presentation, not data

steps.text: Change the value coast to mountains in the table
steps.hint: A click on the value opens the field; the key is not touched

steps.text: Add hiking to the tags list in the editor
steps.hint: The table draws lists read-only

steps.text: Add status: active to the front matter
steps.hint: status is one more property of the header

steps.text: Try the four statuses and look at their glyphs
steps.hint: The glyphs show in the explorer and on the home screen

steps.text: Write a made-up status and see there is no glyph
steps.hint: An unknown value is treated as if there were no status

steps.text: Run :status and choose a status
steps.hint: :status opens the finder already filtered

steps.text: Filter the finder with status:active
steps.hint: The conditions go inside the finder

steps.text: Filter with folder:Travel and a quoted folder
steps.hint: A folder with spaces goes in quotes

steps.text: Combine status, folder and a word
steps.hint: Every condition must hold

steps.text: Run :history on a note with commits
steps.hint: The history is the one in the vault's git

steps.text: Walk the versions with j and k
steps.hint: The wheel moves the list too

steps.text: Restore a version with Enter and undo with u
steps.hint: The version enters the editor as a single change

steps.text: Try :history on a note with no commits
steps.hint: Without git there is no dialog: the bar says why

steps.text: Link to this note from another and look at the list
steps.hint: Backlinks show below the preview

steps.text: Open an unlinked mention with a click
steps.hint: Mentions are notes that name this one without brackets

steps.text: Turn a mention into a link with the link button
steps.hint: The button rewrites every mention in that note

steps.text: Click a row in the backlinks list
steps.hint: It opens the note on the link's line

steps.text: Rename Suitcase and accept updating the links
steps.hint: The question says how many links and in how many notes

steps.text: Link the Suitcase in Home with its path in front
steps.hint: With two notes of the same name, the link carries the folder

steps.text: Create Trip and embed the whole note
steps.hint: An exclamation mark before the link brings the content

steps.text: Embed the Luggage heading of Trip
steps.hint: The # separates the note from the part

steps.text: Embed the booking block of Trip
steps.hint: The ^ says the part is a block, not a heading

steps.text: Embed an image from the vault
steps.hint: The image goes by its name, with no path

lessons.title: File links and dangerous links
lessons.file: A10 File links and dangerous links.md

steps.text: Link a local file and open it
steps.hint: A Markdown link can point to a PDF or an image

steps.text: Try a dangerous link and cancel
steps.hint: The dialog comes with Cancel already selected

steps.text: Open the graph with space g
steps.hint: :graph does the same

steps.text: Move, open, zoom and centre
steps.hint: h and l, j and k, Enter, + and -, and 0 to centre

steps.text: Click, scroll and drag in the graph
steps.hint: The mouse does the same as the keys

steps.text: Write a link and watch the graph update
steps.hint: The graph refreshes by itself

steps.text: Open the global graph with space G
steps.hint: :graph all and the g on the home screen work too

steps.text: Open a missing note from a hollow node
steps.hint: Hollow nodes are links to notes that do not exist

steps.text: Export this note with :export
steps.hint: The PDF appears next to the note

steps.text: Export to a folder and with another name
steps.hint: A folder ends in a slash; a name carries its extension

steps.text: Export another note with space P
steps.hint: space P exports the open note without typing anything

steps.text: Insert a cover with the Cover menu item
steps.hint: Write cover: with the path if you have no image at hand

steps.text: Look at the cover band in the preview
steps.hint: The band takes eight rows above the title

steps.text: Insert a form with the Form menu item
steps.hint: The block comes with a title and two questions

steps.text: Answer the first question with 3 days
steps.hint: The answer goes under the question, with an equals sign

steps.text: Make the second question a date and pick today
steps.hint: The (date) type opens the calendar and writes the date

steps.text: Mark, clear and mark an option again
steps.hint: Another click on the same option clears the answer

steps.text: Mark two options of a multiple-choice question
steps.hint: The answer joins the options with commas

steps.text: Give the rating question three stars
steps.hint: The third star writes a 3

steps.text: Rename, change, require, clear and delete a question
steps.hint: The question's menu keeps the type and the options

steps.text: Add a new question with its name and type
steps.hint: The add question button asks for a name and a type

steps.text: Change the title and the description
steps.hint: A click on each one opens its field

steps.text: Drag a block with the dotted handle
steps.hint: The handle grabs the whole block, not one line

steps.text: Add a block with the + in the margin
steps.hint: The + opens a new line and the menu

steps.text: Look at the handles of the block under the cursor
steps.hint: The handles show when the mouse passes over the preview

steps.text: Change the note from outside and save
steps.hint: The bar says Both kept: and gives the copy's name

steps.text: Delete a note from outside and see the warning
steps.hint: It warns once and asks before recreating it

steps.text: Cause a sync conflict
steps.hint: It needs two copies of the vault touching the same line

steps.text: Check that both texts are there
steps.hint: One in the note and the other in the conflict copy

lessons.title: Editing folders in the editor
lessons.file: A20 Editing folders in the editor.md

steps.text: Open a folder in the editor with m
steps.hint: Each entry is an editable line

steps.text: Create, rename and delete lines and confirm
steps.hint: Nothing is touched until you accept the plan

steps.text: Open the editor from the tree with i, a and o
steps.hint: The key reaches the editor already received

steps.text: Create a file with M and come back
steps.hint: Misoku rereads the folder when mini.files closes

steps.text: Create House project with properties, status and cover
Embed the total block of Budget
Rename Budget and accept updating the links
Export to PDF and open the local graph
Turn an unlinked mention into a link
